common.style_usage: Stardew Valley interior pixel art: palette, outline weight, wood grain and shading, and the high top-down front camera where furniture shows its front with the top as a band above it
common.reference_usage: camera and outline: the front face square-on with its top seen as a band above it; keep this size and shape, bottom edge on the floor

plan_chest.description: one wide low wooden plan chest, an artist's flat file cabinet, Stardew Valley pixel art, the same front-facing angle, size and warm wood as the style image: a stack of many wide shallow drawers, each with a small brass handle and a little paper label, and on its flat top a rolled drawing, a sketchbook or a few loose sheets of paper. Furniture only, transparent background.

lectern.description: one small wooden book stand, a lectern on a single carved post, Stardew Valley pixel art, holding a big open portfolio book with little paintings on its pages, or a closed leather portfolio with a ribbon; seen from the front and a little above. Furniture only, transparent background.
